data.raw_text:
JUST IN: A Bell 505 helicopter with five passengers on board conducted a forced landing in Pililla, Rizal on Tuesday, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) said.

The helicopter was en route from Manila to Quezon Province when the incident occurred.

Two fatalities have been confirmed, while three have been transported to a nearby hospital for medical treatment.

CAAP’s Aircraft Accident Investigation and Inquiry Board is conducting an investigation. | via Rudy Santos
